purpose: Generalized regression inventory for semantic reviewer recall and precision. Cases model defect classes accepted in real review without encoding any one pull request's answer.

cases.counterexample: The two channels are not separate.
cases.review_contract: A negated positive marker must not satisfy an affirmative invariant.

cases.counterexample: It would be wrong to say never combine the alpha and beta channels.
cases.review_contract: Every positive-evidence disjunct must preserve rejection/polarity filtering; intrinsically prohibitive wording is not affirmative evidence when its enclosing proposition is rejected.

cases.source:
def accepted(text):
    return 'approved route' in text
cases.counterexample: The phrase 'approved route' appears only as an example of wording not to use.
cases.review_contract: Quotation or mention-only text must not satisfy affirmative evidence.

cases.source:
def has_remote_action(text):
    return 'remote' in text and 'execute --command' in text
cases.counterexample: Remote collection is discussed here. Local workstation step: execute --command tool.exe.
cases.review_contract: Required scope labels and actions must be bound to the same semantic clause or lane.

cases.source:
def has_local(text):
    return 'local' in text and 'powershell.exe' in text
cases.counterexample: For local use execute --command powershell.exe -File collector.ps1.
cases.review_contract: A command wrapped in a remote/response-action transport must not satisfy a standalone local-command requirement.

cases.source:
def has_retrieve(text):
    return 'get-file --path' in text and 'NEXT_FILE' in text
cases.counterexample: NEXT_FILE and get-file --path are unavailable in this environment.
cases.review_contract: Postposed prohibition or unavailability must invalidate otherwise present action tokens.

cases.source:
def duplicate(lines):
    return sum(line.strip().lower() == 'cleanup' for line in lines) > 1
cases.counterexample:
1. Cleanup: first block
...
2) Cleanup - repeated block
cases.review_contract: Numbering, punctuation, or inline suffixes must not let semantically duplicate section headers evade duplicate detection.

cases.source:
def leaks(text):
    return 'routing state' in text.lower()
cases.review_contract: Equivalent serialized/name variants must be considered when the contract forbids exposing an internal semantic field.

cases.counterexample: A case declares support only for deterministic mode but is selected in fallback mode.
cases.review_contract: Eligibility restrictions must be enforced for every execution mode, not only one specially guarded mode.

cases.source:
def actionable(text):
    return all(token in text for token in ['upload', 'execute', 'retrieve', 'cleanup'])
cases.counterexample: Do not upload, do not execute, do not retrieve, and do not cleanup.
cases.review_contract: Raw token co-occurrence must not be treated as affirmative executable guidance.

cases.counterexample: The string literal is the left operand of a boolean membership expression, not a bare truthy disjunct.
cases.review_contract: Do not report a truthy-literal defect when the literal participates in a valid comparison or membership expression.
